description: Replaces ONE standard line of the participant pages with the host's own wording, for example the hint above the required fields or a standard line of the thank-you copy. Side effect: it writes on the connected WordPress site. The value is stored on the campaign and beats the translation, so it survives a language switch or a rebuild; an EMPTY value deletes the override and the campaign language shows again. Needs `session_id`, `webinar_id`, `key` and `value`. An unknown key is refused with code unknown_label and the list of valid keys, which you then read and never guess. The labels of the form fields (Full Name, Email, Phone) are NOT these lines; they are campaign fields, and the form's own labels are changed with wi_change_registration_fields. The answer names whether the line is reachable on the campaign's pages, so say so plainly when it is not.

key.description: The label key, as the refusal or the settings list names it. Never guessed.

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

value.description: The host's own wording, or an empty string to remove the override.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_change_participant_label
title: Set one standard line of the participant pages
